trigger.request_payload: Review and consolidate QIF v0.2.1 after schema and verifier hardening; produce concept, responsibility, flow, alignment, verifier boundary, package architecture, naming, pilot readiness, and v0.2.2 cleanup recommendations without redesign or feature expansion.

outcome_reports.note: QIF v0.2.1 consolidation review completed: concept map, responsibility matrix, runtime flow review, alignment report, verifier boundary matrix, package architecture recommendation, naming list, v0.3 pilot readiness, and v0.2.2 cleanup tasks are documented.

gaps.summary: The underlying need is not specific enough yet.

asked_questions: Which service touchpoint or environment should this redesign cover, and what should stay out of scope?
How should improvement success be judged: which metric or end state matters most?

user_answers.question: Which service touchpoint or environment should this redesign cover, and what should stay out of scope?
user_answers.answer: Scope: review the existing QIF v0.2.1 repository artifacts only: docs, schemas, examples, local verifiers, npm test behavior, changelog, and AOF runtime evidence. Stay out of scope: redesign from scratch, UI, external integrations, software-development specialization, business discovery expansion, and any claim that verifier success proves semantic quality truth.

user_answers.question: How should improvement success be judged: which metric or end state matters most?
user_answers.answer: Success: produce a consolidation review document covering concept map, entity responsibility matrix, runtime flow review, schema/docs/example/verifier alignment, verifier boundary matrix, package architecture recommendation, naming improvement list, v0.3 pilot readiness assessment, and v0.2.2 cleanup tasks; run npm test and AOF review/self-review/retrospective commands.
